Detailed Definition: Average earnings growth over previous 48 months. Earnings growth is defined as EPS (epspx) minus EPS 12 months ago divided by average EPS 12 and 24 months ago. Exclude if price less than 5, absolute value of 12 month earnings growth greater 600%, or earnings growth and earnings growth 12 months ago have different signs.
